sprint_note: Sprint 06 adds: alcohol (g) report view, avg-line extension to week/month scopes, client-side entry search, quantity_g scaling on log intake + entry detail rescale UX, and the migrations/005_add_quantity_g.sql schema change.
summary: FoodTracker records daily food intake, computes nutritional aggregates, and serves them through a Dataset-based API consumed by the Atlas Shell UI.

classification.why_application: Contains domain-specific meal-logging rules, nutritional scaling logic, and report aggregation that has meaning only within the FoodTracker domain.
non_goals: Protein view for alcohol (no alcohol protein column exists)
Storing per-100g values separately — derivable from quantity_g and stored macros
Search on the Day tab or Standards tab
Rescaling via a dedicated endpoint — rescaling happens in the frontend before PUT
classification.not_platform: Meal logging, nutritional aggregation, and scaling logic encode FoodTracker-specific business rules; they must not become reusable platform capabilities.

provides: GET /api/food/report — Dataset with per-meal-type kcal/protein/alcohol buckets; avg columns when scope in (year, month, week)
GET /api/food/entries — Dataset of food_logs rows (overview schema)
PUT /api/food/entries/:id — full-replace edit; accepts optional quantity_g
POST /api/food/meals — intake with optional quantity_g scaling
GET /api/food/template — plain-text JSON template (updated with quantity_g example)
invariants: quantity_g stored in food_logs is always NULL or > 0 (enforced by DB CHECK constraint)
When quantity_g is present at intake, all stored macro values are quantity_g/100 * per-100g input
Cross-field checks (good_fat_g <= fat_g, red_meat_g <= meat_g) apply to per-100g values before scaling
avg columns (kcal_avg, protein_avg, alcohol_g_avg) are present in rows if and only if scope is year, month, or week
alcohol_g_total included in every report bucket row regardless of scope
Client-side search does not affect backend — GET /api/food/entries response is always unfiltered
failure_modes: VALIDATION_ERROR (422): quantity_g present but not a number > 0
VALIDATION_ERROR (422): any required nutrition field missing or invalid
NOT_FOUND (404): entry id does not exist
INVALID_PARAM (422): scope or mode not in allowed set

provides: HTTP API at /api/food/* (all routes registered via FastAPI router in backend/main.py)

internal_flow.name: report_alcohol_column
internal_flow.description: In _query_logs: add SUM(alcohol_g) AS alcohol_g_total to the SELECT. In _ZERO_METRICS: add alcohol_g_total: 0. In _make_row/_zero_fill: include alcohol_g_total in every row. In REPORT_SCHEMA: add ColumnSchema(key='alcohol_g_total', ...).

internal_flow.name: report_avg_scope_extension
internal_flow.description: Change include_avgs from scope=='year' to scope in ('year','month','week'). The _zero_fill avg computation and the schema extension for avg columns already handle year; extend the same conditional to also emit avg columns for month and week. Query SQL already collects alcohol_g via step 1; add cumulative alcohol_g avg alongside kcal and protein avgs when include_avgs=True.
outputs: kcal_avg, protein_avg, alcohol_g_avg appended to rows when scope in (year, month, week)

internal_flow.name: report_alcohol_avg_schema
internal_flow.description: When include_avgs=True, append ColumnSchema(key='alcohol_g_avg', label='Avg daily alcohol (g)', type='number') to the schema list alongside existing kcal_avg and protein_avg entries.

internal_flow.name: intake_quantity_scaling
internal_flow.description: In _validate_and_normalise (food.py): after existing validation, check for optional top-level quantity_g field. If present and > 0, treat all nutrition.* values as per-100g reference values; scale each macro as stored_value = ref_value * quantity_g / 100. Cross-field checks (good_fat_g <= fat_g, red_meat_g <= meat_g) applied to per-100g values before scaling. quantity_g stored in normalised dict.
outputs: normalised dict with scaled macro values + quantity_g

internal_flow.name: intake_db_insert_quantity_g
internal_flow.description: In commit_meal (food.py): add quantity_g to the INSERT column list and VALUES tuple. When quantity_g is None (absent from intake), store NULL in the column.

internal_flow.name: entry_detail_quantity_g
internal_flow.description: In _serialise_entry_detail (entries.py): add quantity_g serialisation: float(row['quantity_g']) if not None else None. This field is returned in GET /api/food/entries/:id and POST /api/food/entries/:id/copy.

internal_flow.name: entry_edit_quantity_g
internal_flow.description: In _validate_entry_edit_request (entries.py): accept optional quantity_g; validate as number > 0 if present (defaults to None when absent). Add quantity_g = %s to the UPDATE SET clause. quantity_g in validated dict is float | None.

internal_flow.name: copy_entry_quantity_g
internal_flow.description: In copy_entry (entries.py): add quantity_g to the INSERT column list and VALUES (using source['quantity_g'] which may be None). No scaling at copy time — the copy preserves the already-scaled stored macros and the original quantity_g reference.

internal_flow.name: template_quantity_g
internal_flow.description: Update TEMPLATE_JSON string in food.py to include quantity_g as a top-level optional field with a comment indicating it represents per-100g values when provided.

internal_flow.name: frontend_report_alcohol_view
internal_flow.description: In ReportPage.tsx: extend NutMetric type to 'kcal'|'protein'|'alcohol'. Add ALCOHOL_BARS constant. In YearComboPanel (to be renamed AvgComboPanel or left as-is): handle metric==='alcohol' using ALCOHOL_BARS and avgKey='alcohol_g_avg'. Extend View selector with third option. In DataTable: add alcohol branch showing bucket_label, alcohol_g_total, alcohol_g_avg (when present).
outputs: Alcohol (g) view in chart and table

internal_flow.name: frontend_report_avg_scope
internal_flow.description: In ReportPage.tsx: change isYearScope to showAvgLine = scope !== 'all_time'. Use AvgComboPanel/YearComboPanel for week, month, year; use StackedBarPanel only for all_time.
outputs: Average line shown in week and month charts

internal_flow.name: frontend_entries_search
internal_flow.description: In EntriesPage.tsx: add searchQuery/setSearchQuery state (default ''). Add a text input above the entries list (placeholder 'Search dishes...'). Filter entries before passing to GroupedEntries: include entry if dish_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()). When searchQuery is empty/whitespace show all. Date groups with zero matching entries omitted. GroupedEntries component is unchanged.

internal_flow.name: frontend_entry_detail_quantity_rescale
internal_flow.description: In EntryDetailPage.tsx: extend EntryDetail interface with quantity_g: number | null. Extend EntryFormState with quantity_g: number | null. In entryToFormState: map entry.quantity_g. Add quantity_g to _buildPutBody (send null explicitly when null). When entry.quantity_g !== null, show a 'Quantity (g)' input in the edit form. onChange for quantity_g: recompute all macro inputs proportionally (per100g = stored * 100 / original_quantity_g, new_stored = per100g * new_quantity_g / 100). Store per100g reference values in local state when quantity_g is non-null to enable correct proportional rescaling.
outputs: Macro fields updated proportionally in form state
PUT body includes quantity_g and rescaled macros

risks.impact: Per-100g values derived from stored macros via division may accumulate float rounding error; acceptable for display but not losslessly reversible

risks.risk: quantity_g NULL vs 0 ambiguity in legacy rows
risks.impact: Existing rows have quantity_g=NULL meaning 'absolute values'. Queries must treat NULL as 'not scaled' and not as 0.
